extract_tss: extract transcription start sites from a GTF DataFrame for transcript or gene features
upgrade_annotation_ids: upgrade old Ensembl transcript or gene IDs to new patch versions using a mapping
get_gene_interval: get a single stranded genome interval for a gene by symbol or Ensembl ID
get_gene_intervals: get a list of stranded genome intervals for multiple genes by symbols or IDs
filter_to_longest_transcript: filter a GTF DataFrame to keep only the longest transcript per gene
